tooltip.$description: Non-interactive hint shown on hover/focus of a trigger element — pure CSS (:hover/:focus-visible + position:absolute), no JS, no native popover API needed (unlike Popover, a tooltip never needs to be dismissed by an outside click — it just follows the trigger's own hover/focus state). First consumer of surface.inverse/shadow.sm: the one dark, floating surface in the system, needs to read as 'lifted' via a real shadow rather than a border (see shadow.tokens.json's own $description). Single size (no sm/base/lg) — content-width bubble, not a field grid. Small arrow (rotated square, same bg as the bubble) pointing at the trigger — reversed the earlier 'no arrow' call after seeing it live read as ambiguous/floating without one; a caret makes the trigger-tooltip relationship unambiguous at a glance.

gap.$description: 6px offset between the trigger's edge and the tooltip bubble — the arrow occupies part of this gap.

arrowSize.$description: 8px square, rotated 45deg — half (~5.7px) pokes out past the bubble's own edge.

showDelay.$description: Brief delay before appearing, so quickly passing the mouse over a trigger doesn't flash a tooltip — standard practice, not present on hide (disappears immediately once the trigger loses hover/focus).

label.$description: 12px — smaller than the 14px body-base used everywhere else, a tooltip is a brief hint, not reading content.
